# PHPMailer

Vendored release: **v7.2.0**, published 7 November 2026.

Source: https://github.com/PHPMailer/PHPMailer/releases/tag/v7.2.0

The unchanged `src/PHPMailer.php`, `src/SMTP.php`, `src/Exception.php` and `LICENSE` files are included so an ordinary PHP hosting account does not need Composer. License: LGPL, see LICENSE.
